schema_review.rationale: Register the complete 1.3.0 no-vector, Code-disabled Server chain on all three backends, preserving history, existing Source references and pending intents with projection rebuilds and read-only startup admission. Review master 464cd152: the Atomic Memory snapshot budget changes admission and buffering, preserving the snapshot digest and frozen schema/revision resources. Publication requires installed-release upgrade, repeat-apply, old-startup rejection, background Worker execution and fresh-schema equivalence. Optional vector/Code and older Memory layouts need separately registered profiles.
